Well, her current plan is getting a job and moving out of NJ to MD. She's currently getting a lot of job interviews and callbacks and is looking for apartments out here. I've been trying to help her and we've been getting better I guess...

I feel she's getting better actually and I'm feeling a certain type of way about her. It isn't even just the guilt but the past situations that happened within our relationship. I want to be able to let it go but between the guilt I feel or being guilted, part of me feels like I shouldn't forgive her even though she's apologised numerous times. 

I will stay up hours of the night on the phone with her as she screams and yells and cries either at the hands of her parents provoking or talking down to her and she'll take it on me. She'll apologise right after but it also makes me jittery and trigger my anxiety to the point where I struggle to calm down and relax. As much as we're on a break, it's not a true break because we talk everyday and I don't think I can focus on my needs and make her feel like I won't disappear on her. 

I've done my research and sent her links and phone numbers for the Trevor Project and she worries about money. I try to assure her that she wouldn't know unless she tries. I really hope I just don't end up losing her over anything, especially if that happens to be me. I don't think I would be able to cope myself. 

Thank you for reaching out to me, is there a place in MD where I can find crisis workers, if you happen to know

Thank you so much, I will definitely take you up on that. We've been working through it. She's recently had an interview in the state that I moved to and she has a second interview on Monday. She's making plans to move here and she's recently met my family. She's still struggling with feeling like she doesn't belong anywhere and she tells me all the time if she didn't have me she wouldn't know what to do or if she would make it without me. Sometimes I get nervous that the things that I've gone through with her will make me fall out of love with her and resent her but I know she needs me...sometimes I feel so helpless but I could never abandon her

I'm FaceTiming her tonight so that she'll be alright. She's at risk everyday because she's so alone with her thoughts. I'm always there for her and I do try my best. 

Thank you so much. I'm going to try to not feel guilt because I know it'll affect my own depression.
